literal_meaning: চণ্ড এবং চামুণ্ড (দুর্গার দুটি ভয়ঙ্কর রূপের নাম)
figurative_meaning_en: The followers or associates of evil deeds
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গ্যাংয়ের সদস্যরা চণ্ডচামুণ্ডের মতো দুস্কৃতির অনুচর।
রাজনৈতিক দলের কিছু লোক চণ্ডচামুণ্ডের ভূমিকা পালন করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The gang members act like the henchmen of evil, causing chaos everywhere.
Some people in the political party are playing the role of associates of wrongdoing.
history: This idiom draws from Hindu mythology where Chanda and Chamunda are two fierce forms of Goddess Durga, often depicted as destroyers of evil; figuratively, it refers to ruthless followers of miscreants in Bengali cultural expressions.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of demonic or fierce attendants, commonly used in literary or spoken Bengali to denote villainous aides.
